explication: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework. In the primary workflow, a developer invokes the CLI to build CSS; source scanning discovers project files, Oxide extracts utility candidates, and the Tailwind compiler turns those candidates and input CSS into generated CSS. The repository also provides framework integrations, browser tooling, and a separate upgrade CLI with CSS and template migrations. Scanner and extractor relationships are visible in excerpts; several package capabilities are represented from the tree, so links to their internal runtime steps are omitted where evidence is unavailable.
